failure_condition: The SPA route changes to Reports while document.title remains Dashboard or a generic title.
preconditions: Load a different SPA page, then navigate to the Reports case.
interaction_steps: Navigate to Reports without a full reload.
Inspect document title and root accessible name.
expected_outcome: The document title identifies the current page or purpose.
manual_verification_method: Confirm the title after in-app navigation and with assistive technology/browser UI.
dom_testability: Directly testable from the rendered document title.
accessibility_tree_testability: Testable through the root web area's computed name when exposed by Chromium.
limitations: A title assertion is scoped to the current view and does not establish all route titles.
